notes.title: Vector Strain UPDATE 3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Vector Strain has just been updated with the following improvements:

[list]

[*] TRADING CARDS!
[*] difficulty balancing - we heard the community and made some changes to the difficulties to make the game more enjoyable
[*] player ships balancing - again based on the community feedback the player ships got some buffs so they no longer feel under powered
[*] you can now activate the option to reduce the ships' speed when firing
[*] made the collectible medals less obvious so they are harder to be mistaken with enemy bullets
[*] fixed some resolution and aspect ratio issues 

[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We just released our second patch for Vector Strain. Here are the additions/fixes that come with it:

[list]

[*]Unlimited credits are now available through the game's Options
[*]Controls are now customizable
[*]Added the option to move the player ship using the mouse
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the player from exiting the Highscores/Achievements pages under certain circumstances

[/list]

Also, the OST DLC was updated with .flac versions of the tracks!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we released a small patch to address a few issues reported by the players and we also made an addition to the menu pre-game screen. Main modifications below:

[list]

[*] added ships maxed fire preview in pre-game screen
[*] added 1920x1440 resolution option
[*] fixed an issue with 2 players co-op mode that made a player spawn again after depleting all credits in some situations
[*] fixed an issue with the score multiplier display in Stage 4 in "Compact" hud mode

[/list]

Have fun!
